svg.title: A quake 4,000 km away: station SGU, Sand Point, Alaska, magnitude 7.3
svg.desc: Up, radial and transverse records at SGU for 19 minutes on one scale: P, then S on the horizontal channels, then Love waves on T and Rayleigh waves on Z and R.
svg.text: A quake 4,000 km away: station SGU, Sand Point, Alaska, magnitude 7.3
R along the path (+ away from the quake)
One scale for all three records. Filtered 0.05–0.5 Hz (waves 2 to 20 seconds long).
P shakes mostly Z; S shakes mostly R and T; Love waves shake T; Rayleigh waves roll Z and R.
